summary: Complete route/page inventory across the 5 web apps (mobile excluded per task scope). Routers read: artifacts/sme-compliance/src/App.tsx (wouter, base /app, 23 routes), artifacts/console/src/App.tsx (base /console, ClerkShell routes outside standard Layout + capability/role-gated ConsoleRoutes, 3 redirects), artifacts/buyer-portal/src/App.tsx (base /buyer, 6 routes, whole app rides launch-dark buyer_rails/buyer_confirmations), artifacts/landing/src/App.tsx (pathname switch: /, /login, /accept-invite, /reset-password), artifacts/penalty-calculator/src/App.tsx (single public page). launchActive derived from the R62 launch profile plus the nav feature gates in artifacts/sme-compliance/src/components/layout.tsx and artifacts/console/src/components/layout.tsx (links carry feature: money_analytics, collection_accounts, reconciliation, b2c_reporting, statutory_desks, clerk_ai, white_label, erp_connectors). Notable: SME /collections, /bills, /vat pages have no FeatureUnavailable self-gate (only reconciliation and b2c do) even though bills/collections are launch-dark; SME /analytics, /notifications and console /analytics carry no feature gate in nav so they are lit at launch. console/src/pages/gate-metrics.tsx still exists but its route now redirects to /control-centre/activation.
